title: Should be no_chain: CPO ramp -> memory makers

input.event: The ramp of co-packaged optics (CPO) will lift demand for memory chip makers

expected.behavior: The only memory-related excerpt is sc-013 (NVIDIA lists SK hynix, Micron and Samsung as memory suppliers, stance neutral); nothing says CPO lifts memory demand. Expect no_chain with a reason, or a path whose CPO -> memory-demand hop is model_only so no branch is evidenced. sc-013 must not be cited as supporting evidence.

human_review: E4: is the no_chain reason sound (does it name the missing link)
E1: if a chain is built, does it treat a supplier list as demand evidence
notes: Layer B: judges model behavior with a real Haiku call. Checks are driven by the expected fields below (see eval/runner.py).
